tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind panels and the queue.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, the receipt detail pane.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Quoted policy text, computation blocks, table header band.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered table row and menu item.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The receipt open in the detail pane; selected filter.

tokens.name: nav
tokens.usage: Top app bar in both themes: the product's deep navy.

tokens.name: on-nav
tokens.usage: Text and icons on nav.

tokens.name: on-nav-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive nav items and version labels on nav.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around panels (decorative, not a control edge).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects and secondary buttons: 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, column headers, metadata on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions and hints on surface; at least 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action, links, the selected-row marker. Never a status.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected filter chip, info callouts.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Critical severity (GIFT-04): legal exposure, routed to Compliance. Fill or text on surface.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text on critical fills.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Compliance banner and critical finding cards.

tokens.name: high
tokens.usage: High severity and the Flag disposition. Fill or text on surface.

tokens.name: on-high
tokens.usage: Text on high fills.

tokens.name: high-soft
tokens.usage: Background of high finding cards and the cited-line highlight.

tokens.name: medium
tokens.usage: Medium severity. Still a flag (EXC-01). Fill or text on surface.

tokens.name: on-medium
tokens.usage: Text on medium fills.

tokens.name: medium-soft
tokens.usage: Background of medium finding cards.

tokens.name: low
tokens.usage: Low severity and the Review disposition (EXC-01: only low → review). Fill or text on surface.

tokens.name: on-low
tokens.usage: Text on low fills.

tokens.name: low-soft
tokens.usage: Background of low finding cards and review signals.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: Pass disposition and rules checked and passed. Teal, not green, so it never pairs red/green.

tokens.name: on-pass
tokens.usage: Text on pass fills.

tokens.name: pass-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the passed-rules list.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the screen's name.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Alcohol at a client dinner, APAC employee

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Alcohol is never reimbursable for APAC-entity employees.
styles.usage: All running text, table cells, explanations.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, banner leads.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and column headers, sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Sampled weekly by the audit lead

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Amounts, dates, receipt and line IDs, computations. Tabular figures, right-aligned in columns.

styles.name: data-strong
styles.usage: Rule IDs and the receipt ID in a row.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; padding inside compact cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding inline; gap inside a finding card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in the detail pane.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Severity chips, kbd hints, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, finding cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the detail pane.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Disposition badges and filter chips only.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Panels on canvas. Rows and chips stay flat.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, the override reason dialog, the shortcut sheet.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Queue row height in compact density (power users).

tokens.name: row-default
tokens.usage: Queue row height by default; also the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and selects in the app shell.

tokens.name: detail-pane
tokens.usage: Share of the split view given to the receipt detail; the queue keeps the rest.
